Container.Name: Simmer
Container.Overview: Self-hosted recipe saver. Paste a link and get a clean, ad-free, step-by-step recipe with a cook mode. Works out of the box on any site with standard recipe markup; add an Anthropic API key to also extract recipes from pages and video descriptions without it.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid: 100 = users)

Config.Name: Auto update
Config.Description: Check your GitHub repo daily and update Simmer by itself (no Docker registry needed). Set to false to turn off.

Config.Name: Update repo
Config.Description: GitHub repo (owner/name) to take updates from.

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: Only needed if the repo is private (read access).

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Enables AI extraction for pages without recipe markup.

Config.Name: AI Model
Config.Description: Optional. Model used for AI extraction.

Config.Name: Basic Auth User
Config.Description: Optional. Set both user and password to require a login.

Config.Name: Allow private URLs
Config.Description: Allow importing from LAN addresses (disabled by default for safety).
